title: THE GOLDEN CLUE HUNT IS CUT
why: His answer of 2026-10-14: cut the golden clue hunt, keep the golden enemy in every raid. The three clue props, the search circle that shrank to the golden machine, the CLUE callouts and every mark of them are gone, with their words, their code, the clue word to player 2 and their checks. The golden enemy itself stays: one machine or hostile pillager is still gilded in every raid, it is said once when it is picked, and there is no puzzle to find it: it shows as a gold mark on the minimap and the map while it is within 900 of you, and its shine draws wherever it is on screen. It leaves its hoard as before.
now: The golden enemy hunt with clues is gone; the golden enemy is still in every raid.
